endorsements.quote: As with other diagnostic approaches, deep learning-supported methods must be evaluated before integration with the corresponding invasive reference standards, such as IVUS for atherosclerotic plaque quantification, and also externally with fully independent data25.

unlisted_practices: Include a wide range of scanners and scan protocols in AI training data to improve performance.
Perform AI-supported coronary plaque quantification only in vessels with a diameter greater than 2 mm.
Standardize CT acquisition and analysis to mitigate variability in AI-supported plaque quantification.
Validate AI-guided individualized treatment recommendations through prospective, randomized, controlled clinical trials before routine adoption.
Test AI-supported CT plaque analysis versus CT without AI in trials.

screen.reason: This is an expert consensus statement derived from a Delphi process providing recommendations on how to use AI-assisted coronary CT angiography plaque evaluations to guide individualized medical therapy.
